anya-sec: spotted partner CI log that includes KMS-wrapped ciphertext blobs under secret/data/onboard/partnerY and a short-lived SA token. not seeing plaintext. containment needed.

tom-infra: remove IAM binding for svc-partnery@partner.iam.gserviceaccount.com and disable keys. I'll take it.

jamie-sre: revoke any leases on that path: `vault lease revoke -prefix=secret/data/onboard/partnerY/` — taking leases.

vika-devex: recommend envelope-wrap under a transient Vault transit key instead of rotating org KEK. create `incident-wrap-1732100000`. rewrap runner script ready.

incident-bot: job start: secret-incident-1732100000 leases_found=5 sa_keys_found=1

jamie-sre: leases revoked=5. output posted to #eng-oncall.

tom-infra: IAM binding removed and SA keys disabled. blacklist applied.

vika-devex: created transit key and ran rewrap runner for 8 blobs; manifest uploaded to gs://redwood-incident/1732100000/manifest.json. checksums included.

anya-sec: enabled Vault audit file and started forwarding to splunk. Tagging artifacts incident:1732100000.

incident-bot: job update: rewraps_completed=8 blacklist_applied=true audit_forwarding=true

anya-sec: next steps: rotate any remaining long-lived keys, run log sweep for accidental prints, and prepare partner/legal notification. will open postmortem ticket.

vika-devex: integrity check done — sample unwrapping verified. closing containment.
